hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q '"file_path".*docs/[^k][^o].*\.html\|"file_path".*docs/index\.html\|"file_path".*docs/guide/'; then if ! echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '"file_path".*docs/(ko|zh|ja)/'; then echo '[i18n] English doc modified. Run /translate to update ko/zh/ja pages.'; fi; fi
